items.question: How do I book, and how do deposits work?
items.answer: Book online through our booking page or call/text 252-933-7311. Appointments are first come, first served, and your date is held once your deposit is received. The deposit is 35% of your service and goes toward your total.

items.question: What is your cancellation policy?
items.answer: Deposits are fully refundable when you cancel at least 24 hours before your appointment. Cancellations with less than 24 hours notice are nonrefundable. [Read the full policy](policies.html)

items.question: What does mobile detailing involve?
items.answer: Our detailing experts bring a fully equipped mobile unit to your location, whether it’s a house, apartment, condo, or even the barracks. We provide top-notch detailing services right at your doorstep.

items.question: Is there an extra charge for excessive dirt or pet hair?
items.answer: Additional charges may apply for excessive dirt or pet hair removal due to the extra time and effort required. If any fees apply, we’ll inform you before we begin.

items.question: How long does a mobile detailing take?
items.answer: Our services typically range from 1 to 6 hours, depending on the level of detail included in your package and any add-on services that you choose.

items.question: Do you detail more than just cars?
items.answer: Yes! In addition to cars, trucks, and SUVs we detail motorcycles, RVs, boats, ATVs, and golf carts.

items.question: What areas do you service?
items.answer: Jacksonville, Sneads Ferry, Wilmington, Carolina Beach, Hampstead, Swansboro, and all surrounding areas in Eastern NC.

items.question: Why should I consider ceramic coating?
items.answer: Ceramic coating forms a durable, hydrophobic layer that repels water, dirt, and grime, making your vehicle easier to clean. It offers UV protection, enhances gloss, and helps prevent oxidation and minor scratches.

items.question: How long does a ceramic coating last?
items.answer: Our ceramic coatings last between 3 years and a lifetime, depending on the package and maintenance. The 10-year (lifetime) Borophene coating requires an annual inspection to maintain its warranty.

items.question: How do I maintain a ceramic-coated vehicle?
items.answer: Use regular hand washing with pH-neutral soap. We offer a free exterior hand wash 30 days after the ceramic coating. Avoid automatic car washes to preserve the coating’s effectiveness and longevity.
